mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM Manufacturing Index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 45, indicating a contraction in manufacturing activity, it predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the economy heads towards a potential recession.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 45 but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over 3 months signals a rapidly weakening labor market, which predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 55% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) rise by more than 10% year-over-year while the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2%, it signals a housing-led economic boom that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Trigger condition met but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 2% over 6 months, indicating high inflation, predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the Fed is likely to raise interest rates to combat inflation.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL 6-month change > 2% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 55% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and falling, it signals a very tight labor market that will put upward pressure on wages, leading to higher inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4% and falling but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 55% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow by more than 5% year-over-year while the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5%, it signals strong consumer demand that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Trigger condition met but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM Manufacturing Index (proxied by INDPRO) is above 55 and rising, indicating strong manufacturing activity, it predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as the market reacts positively to the improving economic conditions.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 55 and rising but SPX 5-day forward returns are negative > 45% of the time.
